name: Find Ranshalla
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Yes, yes, these feathers seem to hold the same magical enchantment that I noticed previously... While I am not certain what we might find, I urge you to continue searching for answers, adventurer.

A colleague of mine recently traveled into Winterspring to observe the wildkin there, in their own habitat. Why don't you catch up with her and see what she has found?
narrative.offerRewardText: Hi! Erelas sent you? Great, I was just preparing to travel up to the caves now, and I wouldn't mind company.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 47 to 59, 23,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Favored of Elune?
quests.objectiveText: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Moontouched Wildkin
quests.objectiveText: Collect 10 Moontouched Feathers from Winterspring, then return to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Guardians of the Altar
quests.objectiveText: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune.

quests.name: Wildkin of Elune
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
